summary: Implemented a history-derived run summary and ensured it is emitted on success and failure. Added summary schema in output module, refactored CLI run flow to capture partial steps, surface run/output errors, and include output artifacts. Updated extract output writer to return an artifact entry and updated bench runner for new execute_agent return shape.
notes: Summary now includes terminal_state, steps, errors, and output_artifacts; emitted even on startup, run, and output failures. Added notes entry for AGENT-004.
